pages.article_html:
Trapped Unicorns

Level 28 · Adventuring · Wardship Of The Sleeping Moon

The bottom of the Celestine Ward Griffon Tower

Objectives

Find and speak with the unicorn Delsyr to the north of the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon. Once the scattered unicorns are reunited, return to Enorian Andowyn at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon. - Aid Delsyr

Description

Enorian says, "Unfortunately, now the unicorns are stuck in all sorts of places around the Marsh of Peril." "It would be good to see them together again, though." "You'll want to talk to a unicorn named Delsyr. He'll know where the other unicorns have run off to." "Come back and let me know when you have the situation sorted out."

What they say

On offering it

Enorian
Unfortunately, now the unicorns are stuck in all sorts of places around the Marsh of Peril. It would be good to see them together again, though. You'll want to talk to a unicorn named Delsyr. He'll know where the other unicorns have run off to. Come back and let me know when you have the situation sorted out.

Recorded by quest description.

Notes

Delsyr is in the chunk to the north Complete his quest

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Objectives as recorded by fandom

Aid Delsyr Retrieve our Lost Kin Find and speak with the unicorn Delsyr to the north of the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon. Once the scattered unicorns are reunited, return to Enorian Andowyn at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon.

findings.observation: Objectives instruct finding and speaking with Delsyr north of Wardship of the Sleeping Moon, reuniting scattered unicorns, then returning to Enorian Andowyn. Aid Delsyr is an objective label; no numerical rescue count is printed.

The fandom-attributed alternate objective explicitly associates Aid Delsyr with Retrieve our Lost Kin. Notes say Delsyr is in the chunk to the north and to complete his quest. Retrieve Our Lost Kin prints Trapped Unicorns in both Previous and Next. Preserve these narrative and navigation observations without asserting an enforced nested prerequisite or repairing the contradictory sequence.

Details label Enorian Andowyn as both Starts with and Hand in to. Offering dialogue is attributed to Enorian. The article introductory location says the bottom of the Celestine Ward Griffon Tower; Details print 6088, -12465, 10324 in Wardship of the Sleeping Moon (-23, 25). Preserve these contexts separately from the directions to Delsyr.

Previous links One Other Elf and Next links A Marvelous Plan; Series is Unicorn. These are navigation labels, not verified eligibility rules. Header prints Level 28 and Adventuring in Wardship Of The Sleeping Moon.
Coin reward is printed as 60 without denomination. Preserve the source value without converting to copper. No explicit XP, reward items or repeatability are supplied in the cached article.

The archive attributes its primary source to the 20071023052300 Wayback snapshot of vg.mmodb.com:80/quests/trapped-unicorns-2908.php and labels another objective account fandom. Neither original was fetched in this review. Mirrored accounts do not establish independent corroboration or a verified live-era build.
